stemMd: One printer completes a job in 15 minutes and another in 10 minutes. Working simultaneously at their constant rates on separate portions, how many minutes do they need for one job?
explanationMd: Add rates: 1/15+1/10=1/6 job per minute. The reciprocal gives 6 minutes for one job. Adding completion times would not combine work rates correctly.
